## How the score was worked out

Each result implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average, with a small pull toward the middle for thinly tested models. Each test's weight is its *counts* column above; here it is added up by who ran the tests. ## How to run it

<sub>[context source](https://huggingface.co/bigscience/bloom-7b1/blob/6232703e399354503377bf59dfbb8397fd569e4a/README.md): Training sequence length stated by the maker; no separate serving limit is published.</sub>

<pre>
download          size  score
4-bit fp16    ~14.14GB   21.0
4-bit Q4_K_M    ~5.3GB   21.0
8-bit Q8_0      ~8.6GB   21.0
</pre>

<sub>The score is the published model's; quantized downloads haven't been evaluated separately.</sub>

### Run it on your own machine

**llama.cpp** · install: macOS / Linux `curl -LsSf https://llama.app/install.sh | sh` · Windows `irm https://llama.app/install.ps1 | iex` · [other ways](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/blob/master/docs/install.md) · Homebrew and winget installs name the commands llama-cli and llama-server instead.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~5.3GB
llama cli -hf mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~8.6GB
llama cli -hf mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF:Q8_0
# or start a local server and open the address it prints (http://localhost:9931)
llama serve -hf mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**LM Studio** · install: [macOS / Windows / Linux](https://lmstudio.ai/download) · Open the app once before using the lms command.

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~5.3GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF@Q4_K_M -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~8.6GB
lms get https://huggingface.co/mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF@Q8_0 -y
# then run lms ls to see its name, and lms chat followed by that name
```

**Ollama** · install: [macOS / Windows](https://ollama.com/download) · Linux `curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`

```sh
# 4-bit Q4_K_M · ~5.3GB
ollama run hf.co/mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF:Q4_K_M
# 8-bit Q8_0 · ~8.6GB
ollama run hf.co/mradermacher/bloom-7b1-GGUF:Q8_0
```

**Other engines**

```sh
# 4-bit fp16 · ~14.14GB
uv run --with torch --with 'transformers<5' --with accelerate python -c "from transformers import pipeline; print(pipeline('text-generation', model='bigscience/bloom-7b1', torch_dtype='auto', device_map='auto')('Once upon a time', max_new_tokens=40)[0]['generated_text'])"
```
